objective: Derive a strict external evaluation source-artifact digest mechanically from an exact Git commit rather than mutable local state or an opaque manual hash.
findings: `git archive --format=tar <exact commit>` provides a commit-object source artifact that is independent of dirty or untracked working-tree state.
The archive SHA-256 can be fed directly into the strict external evaluation request subject and validated before an evaluator run.
This improves subject reproducibility but does not establish model/runtime identity or evaluator independence.
claim_boundary: This is internal development evidence. It documents external-evaluation scaffolding and cannot satisfy any independent production AGI criterion by itself.
